# Temple Scroll Column 25 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Temple Scroll Column 25 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 25:1 — "a square all around" vs. "forming a square" vs. "a perfect square"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a square all around" | Literal rendering preserving Hebrew phrasing |
| LOGOS | "forming a square on all sides" | Natural English expression |
| PNEUMA | "a perfect square" | Adds "perfect" for emphasis |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS variant: "a square on all sides." Clear without PNEUMA's interpretive "perfect."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 25:5 — "capitals" vs. "crowning capitals"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "capitals" | Standard architectural term |
| LOGOS | "capitals" | Standard rendering |
| PNEUMA | "crowning capitals" | Adds "crowning" for visual emphasis |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS: "capitals." The adjective "crowning" is redundant since capitals by definition crown columns.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 25:9 — "rooms" vs. "chambers"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "rooms" | Simple English for lishkot |
| LOGOS | "chambers" | More formal architectural register |
| PNEUMA | "rooms" | Accessible modern English |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "rooms" (EMET/PNEUMA). While "chambers" has a more formal register, "rooms" is clear and avoids archaism. Used consistently throughout the column.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/PNEUMA.

---

## 25:13 — "courses" vs. "divisions" vs. "rotations"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "courses" | Traditional English for mishmarot in temple context |
| LOGOS | "divisions" | Standard DSS scholarly rendering |
| PNEUMA | "rotations" | Modern term conveying the shift-based service |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS: "divisions." Standard rendering in Dead Sea Scrolls scholarship. "Courses" (EMET) is traditional but less precise; "rotations" (PNEUMA) is overly modern.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 25:13 — "elders of the priests" vs. "senior priests"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "elders of the priests" | Literal rendering of ziqnei hakohanim |
| LOGOS | "senior priests" | Concise English equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "senior priests" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS/PNEUMA: "senior priests." More natural English than the literal construct chain while preserving the meaning of hierarchical seniority.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/PNEUMA.

---

## 25:16 — "most holy" vs. "supremely sacred"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "most holy" | Standard rendering |
| LOGOS | "most holy" | Traditional |
| PNEUMA | "supremely sacred" | Fresh phrasing |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS: "most holy." Consistent with project convention for qodesh qodashim.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---
